modules.title: The Georgi-Glashow Model
modules.doc:
The Georgi-Glashow model is a grand unified theory that unifies the Standard Model gauge group into
`SU(5)`.

This file currently contains informal-results about the Georgi-Glashow group.

## References

* Baez's Grand Unified Theories notes, cited throughout below. [ref: baez_guts_notes]

modules.title: The Pati-Salam Model
modules.doc:
The Pati-Salam model is a petite unified theory that unifies the Standard Model gauge group into
`SU(4) x SU(2) x SU(2)`.

This file currently contains informal-results about the Pati-Salam group.

## References

* Baez's Grand Unified Theories notes, cited throughout below. [ref: baez_guts_notes]
* A reference for the kernel of `inclSM`, cited below. [ref: arxiv_2201_07245]

modules.title: Anomaly cancellation conditions for the Standard Model with right-handed neutrinos
modules.doc:
This directory is related to the anomaly cancellation conditions (ACCs) for the Standard Model with
right-handed neutrinos (SMν).

declarations.name: SMνCharges
declarations.doc: The vector space of charges corresponding to the SM fermions with RHN.
declarations.statement: def SMνCharges (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemCharges

declarations.name: SMνSpecies
declarations.doc: The vector spaces of charges of one species of fermions in the SM.
declarations.statement: def SMνSpecies (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemCharges

declarations.name: SMνCharges.sum_one
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_one  [AddCommMonoid M] (f : Fin (SMνSpecies 1).numberCharges → M) :
    ∑ i, f i = f ⟨0, by simp⟩

declarations.name: SMνCharges.toSpeciesEquiv
declarations.doc:
An equivalence between `(SMνCharges n).charges` and `(Fin 6 → Fin n → ℚ)`
splitting the charges into species.
declarations.statement: def toSpeciesEquiv : (SMνCharges n).Charges ≃ (Fin 6 → Fin n → ℚ)

declarations.name: SMνCharges.toSpecies
declarations.doc: Given an `i ∈ Fin 6`, the projection of charges onto a given species.
declarations.statement: def toSpecies (i : Fin 6) : (SMνCharges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνSpecies n).Charges

declarations.name: SMνCharges.charges_eq_toSpecies_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma charges_eq_toSpecies_eq (S T : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    S = T ↔ ∀ i, toSpecies i S = toSpecies i T

declarations.name: SMνCharges.toSMSpecies_toSpecies_inv
declarations.statement:
lemma toSMSpecies_toSpecies_inv (i : Fin 6) (f : Fin 6 → Fin n → ℚ) :
    (toSpecies i) (toSpeciesEquiv.symm f) = f i

declarations.name: SMνCharges.toSpecies_one
declarations.statement:
lemma toSpecies_one (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    toSpecies j S ⟨0, zero_lt_succ 0⟩ = S j

declarations.name: SMνCharges.Q
declarations.doc: The `Q` charges as a map `Fin n → ℚ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev Q

declarations.name: SMνCharges.U
declarations.doc: The `U` charges as a map `Fin n → ℚ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev U

declarations.name: SMνCharges.D
declarations.doc: The `D` charges as a map `Fin n → ℚ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev D

declarations.name: SMνCharges.L
declarations.doc: The `L` charges as a map `Fin n → ℚ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev L

declarations.name: SMνCharges.E
declarations.doc: The `E` charges as a map `Fin n → ℚ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev E

declarations.name: SMνCharges.N
declarations.doc: The `N` charges as a map `Fin n → ℚ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev N

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accGrav
declarations.doc: The gravitational anomaly equation.
declarations.statement: def accGrav : (SMνCharges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accGrav_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma accGrav_decomp (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accGrav S = 6 * ∑ i, Q S i + 3 * ∑ i, U S i + 3 * ∑ i, D S i + 2 * ∑ i, L S i + ∑ i, E S i +
      ∑ i, N S i

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accGrav_ext
declarations.doc: Extensionality lemma for `accGrav`.

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accSU2
declarations.doc: The `SU(2)` anomaly equation.
declarations.statement: def accSU2 : (SMνCharges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accSU2_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma accSU2_decomp (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accSU2 S = 3 * ∑ i, Q S i + ∑ i, L S i

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accSU2_ext
declarations.doc: Extensionality lemma for `accSU2`.

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accSU3
declarations.doc: The `SU(3)` anomaly equations.
declarations.statement: def accSU3 : (SMνCharges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accSU3_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma accSU3_decomp (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accSU3 S = 2 * ∑ i, Q S i + ∑ i, U S i + ∑ i, D S i

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accSU3_ext
declarations.doc: Extensionality lemma for `accSU3`.

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accYY
declarations.doc: The `Y²` anomaly equation.
declarations.statement: def accYY : (SMνCharges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accYY_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma accYY_decomp (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accYY S = ∑ i, Q S i + 8 * ∑ i, U S i + 2 * ∑ i, D S i + 3 * ∑ i, L S i + 6 * ∑ i, E S i

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accYY_ext
declarations.doc: Extensionality lemma for `accYY`.

declarations.name: SMνACCs.quadBiLin
declarations.doc: The quadratic bilinear map.
declarations.statement: def quadBiLin : BiLinearSymm (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMνACCs.quadBiLin_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma quadBiLin_decomp (S T : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    quadBiLin S T = ∑ i, Q S i * Q T i - 2 * ∑ i, U S i * U T i +
        ∑ i, D S i * D T i - ∑ i, L S i * L T i + ∑ i, E S i * E T i

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accQuad
declarations.doc: The quadratic anomaly cancellation condition.
declarations.statement: def accQuad : HomogeneousQuadratic (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accQuad_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma accQuad_decomp (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accQuad S = ∑ i, (Q S i)^2 - 2 * ∑ i, (U S i)^2 + ∑ i, (D S i)^2 - ∑ i, (L S i)^2
    + ∑ i, (E S i)^2

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accQuad_ext
declarations.doc: Extensionality lemma for `accQuad`.
declarations.statement:
lemma accQuad_ext {S T : (SMνCharges n).Charges}
    (h : ∀ j, ∑ i, ((fun a => a^2) ∘ toSpecies j S) i =
    ∑ i, ((fun a => a^2) ∘ toSpecies j T) i) :
    accQuad S = accQuad T

declarations.name: SMνACCs.cubeTriLin
declarations.doc: The symmetric trilinear form used to define the cubic acc.
declarations.statement: def cubeTriLin : TriLinearSymm (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMνACCs.cubeTriLin_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma cubeTriLin_decomp (S T R : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    cubeTriLin S T R = 6 * ∑ i, (Q S i * Q T i * Q R i) + 3 * ∑ i, (U S i * U T i * U R i) +
      3 * ∑ i, (D S i * D T i * D R i) + 2 * ∑ i, (L S i * L T i * L R i) +
      ∑ i, (E S i * E T i * E R i) + ∑ i, (N S i * N T i * N R i)

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accCube
declarations.doc: The cubic ACC.
declarations.statement: def accCube : HomogeneousCubic (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accCube_decomp
declarations.statement:
lemma accCube_decomp (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accCube S = 6 * ∑ i, (Q S i)^3 + 3 * ∑ i, (U S i)^3 + 3 * ∑ i, (D S i)^3 + 2 * ∑ i, (L S i)^3 +
      ∑ i, (E S i)^3 + ∑ i, (N S i)^3

declarations.name: SMνACCs.accCube_ext
declarations.doc: Extensionality lemma for `accCube`.
declarations.statement:
lemma accCube_ext {S T : (SMνCharges n).Charges}
    (h : ∀ j, ∑ i, ((fun a => a^3) ∘ toSpecies j S) i =
    ∑ i, ((fun a => a^3) ∘ toSpecies j T) i) :
    accCube S = accCube T

modules.title: Family maps for the Standard Model for RHN ACCs
modules.doc: We define the a series of maps between the charges for different numbers of families.

declarations.name: SMRHN.chargesMapOfSpeciesMap
declarations.doc: Given a map of for a generic species, the corresponding map for charges.
declarations.statement:
def chargesMapOfSpeciesMap {n m : ℕ} (f : (SMνSpecies n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνSpecies m).Charges) :
    (SMνCharges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνCharges m).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.chargesMapOfSpeciesMap_toSpecies
declarations.statement:
lemma chargesMapOfSpeciesMap_toSpecies {n m : ℕ}
    (f : (SMνSpecies n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνSpecies m).Charges)
    (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    toSpecies j (chargesMapOfSpeciesMap f S) = (LinearMap.comp f (toSpecies j)) S

declarations.name: SMRHN.speciesFamilyProj
declarations.doc: The projection of the `m`-family charges onto the first `n`-family charges for species.
declarations.statement:
def speciesFamilyProj {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    (SMνSpecies m).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνSpecies n).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyProjection
declarations.doc: The projection of the `m`-family charges onto the first `n`-family charges.
declarations.statement: def familyProjection {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : (SMνCharges m).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.speciesEmbed
declarations.doc:
For species, the embedding of the `m`-family charges onto the `n`-family charges, with all
other charges zero.
declarations.statement:
def speciesEmbed (m n : ℕ) :
    (SMνSpecies m).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνSpecies n).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyEmbedding
declarations.doc:
The embedding of the `m`-family charges onto the `n`-family charges, with all
other charges zero.
declarations.statement: def familyEmbedding (m n : ℕ) : (SMνCharges m).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.speciesFamilyUniversial
declarations.doc:
For species, the embedding of the `1`-family charges into the `n`-family charges in
a universal manner.
declarations.statement:
def speciesFamilyUniversial (n : ℕ) :
    (SMνSpecies 1).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνSpecies n).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal
declarations.doc:
The embedding of the `1`-family charges into the `n`-family charges in
a universal manner.
declarations.statement: def familyUniversal (n : ℕ) : (SMνCharges 1).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (SMνCharges n).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.toSpecies_familyUniversal
declarations.statement:
lemma toSpecies_familyUniversal {n : ℕ} (j : Fin 6) (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) : toSpecies j (familyUniversal n S) i = toSpecies j S ⟨0, by simp⟩

declarations.name: SMRHN.sum_familyUniversal
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_familyUniversal {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    ∑ i, ((fun a => a ^ m) ∘ toSpecies j (familyUniversal n S)) i =
    n * (toSpecies j S ⟨0, by simp⟩) ^ m

declarations.name: SMRHN.sum_familyUniversal_one
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_familyUniversal_one {n : ℕ} (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    ∑ i, toSpecies j (familyUniversal n S) i = n * (toSpecies j S ⟨0, by simp⟩)

declarations.name: SMRHN.sum_familyUniversal_two
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_familyUniversal_two {n : ℕ} (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges)
    (T : (SMνCharges n).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    ∑ i, (toSpecies j (familyUniversal n S) i * toSpecies j T i) =
    (toSpecies j S ⟨0, by simp⟩) * ∑ i, toSpecies j T i

declarations.name: SMRHN.sum_familyUniversal_three
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_familyUniversal_three {n : ℕ} (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges)
    (T L : (SMνCharges n).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    ∑ i, (toSpecies j (familyUniversal n S) i * toSpecies j T i * toSpecies j L i) =
    (toSpecies j S ⟨0, by simp⟩) * ∑ i, toSpecies j T i * toSpecies j L i

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_accGrav
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_accGrav (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) :
    accGrav (familyUniversal n S) = n * (accGrav S)

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_accSU2
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_accSU2 (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) :
    accSU2 (familyUniversal n S) = n * (accSU2 S)

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_accSU3
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_accSU3 (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) :
    accSU3 (familyUniversal n S) = n * (accSU3 S)

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_accYY
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_accYY (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) :
    accYY (familyUniversal n S) = n * (accYY S)

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_quadBiLin
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_quadBiLin (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) (T : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    quadBiLin (familyUniversal n S) T =
    S (0 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, Q T i - 2 * S (1 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, U T i + S (2 : Fin 6) *∑ i, D T i -
    S (3 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, L T i + S (4 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, E T i

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_accQuad
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_accQuad (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) :
    accQuad (familyUniversal n S) = n * (accQuad S)

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_cubeTriLin
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_cubeTriLin (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) (T R : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    cubeTriLin (familyUniversal n S) T R = 6 * S (0 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, (Q T i * Q R i) +
      3 * S (1 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, (U T i * U R i) + 3 * S (2 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, (D T i * D R i)
      + 2 * S (3 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, (L T i * L R i) +
      S (4 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, (E T i * E R i) + S (5 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, (N T i * N R i)

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_cubeTriLin'
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_cubeTriLin' (S T : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) (R : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    cubeTriLin (familyUniversal n S) (familyUniversal n T) R =
      6 * S (0 : Fin 6) * T (0 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, Q R i +
      3 * S (1 : Fin 6) * T (1 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, U R i
      + 3 * S (2 : Fin 6) * T (2 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, D R i +
      2 * S (3 : Fin 6) * T (3 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, L R i +
      S (4 : Fin 6) * T (4 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, E R i + S (5 : Fin 6) * T (5 : Fin 6) * ∑ i, N R i

declarations.name: SMRHN.familyUniversal_accCube
declarations.statement:
lemma familyUniversal_accCube (S : (SMνCharges 1).Charges) :
    accCube (familyUniversal n S) = n * (accCube S)

modules.title: ACC system for SM with RHN and no gravitational anomaly.
modules.doc:
We define the ACC system for the Standard Model with right-handed neutrinos and no gravitational
anomaly.

declarations.name: SMRHN.SMNoGrav

declarations.name: SMRHN.SMNoGrav.cubeSol

modules.title: Dimension 7 plane
modules.doc:
We work here in the three family case.
We give an example of a 7 dimensional plane on which every point satisfies the ACCs.

The main result of this file is `seven_dim_plane_exists` which states that there exists a
7 dimensional plane of charges on which every point satisfies the ACCs.

declarations.name: SMRHN.SM.PlaneSeven.B₀
declarations.doc: A charge assignment forming one of the basis elements of the plane.
declarations.statement: def B₀ : (SM 3).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.SM.PlaneSeven.B₀_cubic
declarations.statement:
lemma B₀_cubic (S T : (SM 3).Charges) : cubeTriLin B₀ S T =
    6 * (S (0 : Fin 18) * T (0 : Fin 18) - S (1 : Fin 18) * T (1 : Fin 18))

declarations.name: SMRHN.SM.PlaneSeven.B₁
declarations.doc: A charge assignment forming one of the basis elements of the plane.
declarations.statement: def B₁ : (SM 3).Charges

declarations.name: SMRHN.SM.PlaneSeven.B₁_cubic
declarations.statement:
lemma B₁_cubic (S T : (SM 3).Charges) : cubeTriLin B₁ S T =
    3 * (S (3 : Fin 18) * T (3 : Fin 18) - S (4 : Fin 18) * T (4 : Fin 18))

declarations.name: SMRHN.SM.PlaneSeven.B₂

declarations.name: SMRHN.repCharges_toSpecies
declarations.statement:
lemma repCharges_toSpecies (f : PermGroup n) (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    toSpecies j (repCharges f S) = toSpecies j S ∘ f⁻¹ j

declarations.name: SMRHN.toSpecies_sum_invariant
declarations.statement:
lemma toSpecies_sum_invariant (m : ℕ) (f : PermGroup n) (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) (j : Fin 6) :
    ∑ i, ((fun a => a ^ m) ∘ toSpecies j (repCharges f S)) i =
    ∑ i, ((fun a => a ^ m) ∘ toSpecies j S) i

declarations.statement:
lemma accGrav_invariant (f : PermGroup n) (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :
    accGrav (repCharges f S) = accGrav S

declarations.statement:
lemma accSU2_invariant (f : PermGroup n) (S : (SMνCharges n).Charges) :

declarations.name: SMRHN.accSU3_invariant

declarations.name: SMRHN.accYY_invariant
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: SMRHN.accQuad_invariant
declarations.statement:

declarations.statement:

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: SMRHN.PlusU1.BL.addQuad_zero
declarations.statement: lemma addQuad_zero (S : (PlusU1 n).QuadSols) (a : ℚ) : addQuad S a 0 = a • S

declarations.statement:
lemma on_cubeTriLin (S : (PlusU1 n).Charges) :

declarations.name: SMRHN.PlusU1.BL.on_cubeTriLin_AFL
declarations.statement:
lemma on_cubeTriLin_AFL (S : (PlusU1 n).LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (BL n).val (BL n).val S.val = 0

declarations.name: SMRHN.PlusU1.BL.add_AFL_cube
declarations.statement:
lemma add_AFL_cube (S : (PlusU1 n).LinSols) (a b : ℚ) :
    accCube (a • S.val + b • (BL n).val) =
    a ^ 2 * (a * accCube S.val + 3 * b * cubeTriLin S.val S.val (BL n).val)

We place an upper bound on the dimension of a plane of charges on which every point is a solution.
The upper bound is 7, proven in the theorem `plane_exists_dim_le_7`.

Working in the three family case, we show that there exists an eleven dimensional plane in the
vector space of charges on which there are no solutions.

The main result of this file is `eleven_dim_plane_of_no_sols_exists`, which states that
an 11 dimensional plane of charges exists on which there are no solutions except the origin.

modules.title: Properties of Quad Sols for SM with RHN
modules.doc:
We give a series of properties held by solutions to the quadratic equation.

In particular given a quad solution we define a map from linear solutions to quadratic solutions
and show that it is a surjection.

## References

* The main reference for this is https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.03588. [ref: arxiv_2006_03588]

    accQuad (a • S.val + b • C.val) =
    a * (a * accQuad S.val + 2 * b * quadBiLin S.val C.val)

We use $B-L$ to form a surjective map from quad solutions to solutions.

## References

modules.title: The Spin(10) Model
modules.doc:
Note: By physicists this is usually called SO(10). However, the true gauge group involved
is Spin(10).

## References

* Baez's Grand Unified Theories notes, cited throughout below. [ref: baez_guts_notes]

modules.title: The Two Higgs Doublet Model
modules.doc:
The two Higgs doublet model is the standard model plus an additional Higgs doublet.

## i. Overview

The two Higgs doublet model (2HDM) is an extension of the Standard Model which adds a second Higgs
doublet.

## References

* https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184. [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184]
* https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.03237. [ref: arxiv_1605_03237]

sections.text: ## A. The configuration space
## B. Gauge group actions

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet
declarations.doc:
The configuration space of the two Higgs doublet model.
In otherwords, the underlying vector space associated with the model.
declarations.statement:
structure TwoHiggsDoublet where
  /-- The first Higgs doublet. -/

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.ext_of_fst_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma ext_of_fst_snd {H1 H2 : TwoHiggsDoublet}
    (h1 : H1.Φ1 = H2.Φ1) (h2 : H1.Φ2 = H2.Φ2) : H1 = H2

modules.title: The gram matrix for the two Higgs doublet model
modules.doc:
We will show that the gram matrix of the two Higgs doublet model
describes the gauge orbits of the configuration space.

## References

* The main reference for material in this section is https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-ph/0605184. [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184]

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq {H : TwoHiggsDoublet} (h1 : H.Φ1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI,
      HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI g H.Φ1 = (!₂[0, ‖H.Φ1‖] : HiggsVec) ∧
      (HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI g H.Φ2) 1 = ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ / ‖H.Φ1‖ ∧
      ‖(HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI g H.Φ2) 0‖ = Real.sqrt (H.gramMatrix.det.re) / ‖H.Φ1‖

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq_snd_eq
declarations.doc:
Every two-Higgs-doublet configuration with `Φ1 ≠ 0` can be gauge-fixed to
`Φ1 = (0, ‖Φ1‖)`, with the charged component of `Φ2` real and non-negative.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq_snd_eq {H : TwoHiggsDoublet} (h1 : H.Φ1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI,
      HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI g H.Φ1 = (!₂[0, ‖H.Φ1‖] : HiggsVec) ∧
      HiggsVec.repGaugeGroupI g H.Φ2 =
        (!₂[√(H.gramMatrix.det.re) / ‖H.Φ1‖, ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ / ‖H.Φ1‖] : HiggsVec)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.mem_orbit_gaugeGroupI_iff_gramMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_orbit_gaugeGroupI_iff_gramMatrix (H1 H2 : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H1 ∈ MulAction.orbit GaugeGroupI H2 ↔ H1.gramMatrix = H2.gramMatrix

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_surjective_det_tr
declarations.statement:
lemma gramMatrix_surjective_det_tr (K : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

    ∃ H : TwoHiggsDoublet, H.gramMatrix = K

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector
declarations.doc: A real vector containing the components of the Gram matrix in the Pauli basis.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_eq
declarations.doc: The lemma manifesting the definitional equality for the gramVector.
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_eq (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : H.gramVector = fun μ =>
    2 * PauliMatrix.pauliBasis.repr ⟨gramMatrix H, gramMatrix_selfAdjoint H⟩ μ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_fst_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_fst_gramVector (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI)
    (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (g • H).gramVector μ = H.gramVector μ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_eq_gramVector_sum_pauliMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma gramMatrix_eq_gramVector_sum_pauliMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    gramMatrix H = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ∑ μ, H.gramVector μ • PauliMatrix.pauliMatrix μ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_eq_component_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma gramMatrix_eq_component_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    gramMatrix H =
    !![(1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) + H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2)),
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) - Complex.I * H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1));
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) + Complex.I * H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1)),
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) - H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2))]

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inl_eq_trace_gramMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inl_eq_trace_gramMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) = H.gramMatrix.trace.re

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inl_nonneg
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inl_nonneg (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    0 ≤ H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.normSq_Φ1_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma normSq_Φ1_eq_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 = (1/2 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) + H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2))

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.normSq_Φ2_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma normSq_Φ2_eq_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 = (1/2 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) - H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2))

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.Φ1_inner_Φ2_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma Φ1_inner_Φ2_eq_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ) = (1/2 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) +
    Complex.I * H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1))

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.Φ2_inner_Φ1_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma Φ2_inner_Φ1_eq_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    (⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ) = (1/2 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) -
    Complex.I * H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1))

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.Φ1_inner_Φ2_normSq_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma Φ1_inner_Φ2_normSq_eq_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    ‖⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ‖ ^ 2 =
    (1/4 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) ^ 2 + H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1) ^ 2)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inl_zero_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inl_zero_eq (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) = ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 + ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inl_zero_eq_gramMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inl_zero_eq_gramMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) = (H.gramMatrix 0 0).re + (H.gramMatrix 1 1).re

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_zero_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_zero_eq (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) = 2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).re

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_zero_eq_gramMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_zero_eq_gramMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) = 2 * (H.gramMatrix 1 0).re

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_one_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_one_eq (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1) = 2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).im

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_one_eq_gramMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_one_eq_gramMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1) = 2 * (H.gramMatrix 1 0).im

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_two_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_two_eq (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2) = ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 - ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_two_eq_gramMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_two_eq_gramMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2) = (H.gramMatrix 0 0).re - (H.gramMatrix 1 1).re

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_det_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma gramMatrix_det_eq_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.gramMatrix.det.re =
    (1/4 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2 -
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, H.gramVector (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_sum_sq_le_inl
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_inr_sum_sq_le_inl (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, H.gramVector (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2 ≤ H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_surjective
declarations.statement:
lemma gramVector_surjective (v : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (h_inl : 0 ≤ v (Sum.inl 0))
    (h_det : ∑ μ : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2 ≤ v (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2) :
    ∃ H : TwoHiggsDoublet, H.gramVector = v

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.mem_orbit_gaugeGroupI_iff_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_orbit_gaugeGroupI_iff_gramVector (H1 H2 : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H1 ∈ MulAction.orbit GaugeGroupI H2 ↔ H1.gramVector = H2.gramVector

modules.title: The potential of the Two Higgs doublet model
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In this module we give the define the parameters of the 2HDM potential, and
give stability properties of the potential.

## ii. Key results

- `PotentialParameters` : The parameters of the 2HDM potential.
- `massTerm` : The mass term of the 2HDM potential.
- `quarticTerm` : The quartic term of the 2HDM potential.
- `potential` : The full potential of the 2HDM.
- `PotentialIsStable` : The condition that the potential is stable.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The parameters of the potential
  - A.1. The potential parameters corresponding to zero
  - A.2. Gram parameters
  - A.3. Specific cases
- B. The mass term
- C. The quartic term
- D. The full potential
- E. Stability of the potential
  - E.1. The stability condition
  - E.2. Instability of the stabilityCounterExample potential
  - E.3. The reduced mass term
  - E.4. The reduced quartic term
  - E.5. Stability in terms of the gram vectors
  - E.6. Strong stability implies stability
  - E.7. Showing step in hep-ph/0605184 is invalid

## iv. References

* For the parameterization of the potential we follow the convention of
  https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.03237. [ref: arxiv_1605_03237]
* Stability arguments of the potential follow, in part, those from
  https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184, although we note that we explicitly prove that one of
  the steps in this paper is not valid. [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184]

sections.text:
## A. The parameters of the potential

We define a type for the parameters of the Higgs potential in the 2HDM.

We follow the convention of `1605.03237` [ref: arxiv_1605_03237], which is highlighted in the
explicit construction of the potential itself.

We relate these parameters to the `ξ` and `η` parameters used in the gram vector formalism
given in arXiv:hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].

### A.1. The potential parameters corresponding to zero

We define an instance of `Zero` for the potential parameters, corresponding to all
parameters being zero, and therefore the potential itself being zero.

### A.2. Gram parameters

A reparameterization of the potential parameters corresponding to `ξ` and `η` in
arXiv:hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].
### A.3. Specific cases

## B. The mass term

We define the mass term of the potential, write it in terms of the gram vector,
and prove that it is gauge invariant.

## C. The quartic term

We define the quartic term of the potential, write it in terms of the gram vector,
and prove that it is gauge invariant.

## D. The full potential

We define the full potential as the sum of the mass and quartic terms,
and prove that it is gauge invariant.
## E. Stability of the potential

### E.1. The stability condition

We define the condition that the potential is stable, that is, bounded from below.
### E.2. Instability of the stabilityCounterExample potential

### E.3. The reduced mass term

The reduced mass term is a function that helps express the stability condition.
It is the function `J2` in https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].

### E.4. The reduced quartic term

The reduced quartic term is a function that helps express the stability condition.
It is the function `J4` in https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].

### E.5. Stability in terms of the gram vectors

We give some necessary and sufficient conditions for the potential to be stable
in terms of the gram vectors.

This follows the analysis in https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].

We also give some necessary conditions.

### E.6. Strong stability implies stability

Stability in terms of the positivity of the quartic term, implies that the whole
potential is stable.
### E.7. Showing step in hep-ph/0605184 is invalid

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters
declarations.doc:
The parameters of the Two Higgs doublet model potential.
Following the convention of https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.03237 [ref: arxiv_1605_03237].
declarations.statement:
structure PotentialParameters where
  /-- The parameter corresponding to `m₁₁²` in the 2HDM potential. -/
  m₁₁2 : ℝ
  /-- The parameter corresponding to `m₂₂²` in the 2HDM potential. -/
  m₂₂2 : ℝ
  /-- The parameter corresponding to `m₁₂²` in the 2HDM potential. -/
  m₁₂2 : ℂ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample
declarations.doc:
An example of potential parameters that serve as a counterexample to the stability
condition given in arXiv:hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].
This corresponds to the potential:
`2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).im + ‖H.Φ1 - H.Φ2‖ ^ 4`
which has the property that the quartic term is non-negative and only zero if
the mass term is also zero, but the potential is not stable.
In the proof that `stabilityCounterExample_not_potentialIsStable`, we give
explicit vectors `H.Φ1` and `H.Φ2` that show this potential is not stable.

This is the first occurrence of such a counterexample in the literature to the best of
the author's knowledge.
declarations.statement: def stabilityCounterExample : PotentialParameters

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample_ξ
declarations.statement:
lemma stabilityCounterExample_ξ :
    stabilityCounterExample.ξ = fun
      | .inl 0 => 0
      | .inr 0 => 0
      | .inr 1 => 1
      | .inr 2 => 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample_η
declarations.statement:
lemma stabilityCounterExample_η :
    stabilityCounterExample.η = fun μ => fun ν =>
    match μ, ν with
    | .inl 0, .inl 0 => 1
    | .inl 0, .inr 0 => -1
    | .inl 0, .inr 1 => 0
    | .inl 0, .inr 2 => 0
    | .inr 0, .inl 0 => -1
    | .inr 1, .inl 0 => 0
    | .inr 2, .inl 0 => 0
    | .inr 0, .inr 0 => 1
    | .inr 1, .inr 1 => 0
    | .inr 2, .inr 2 => 0
    | .inr 0, .inr 1 => 0
    | .inr 2, .inr 0 => 0
    | .inr 2, .inr 1 => 0
    | .inr 1, .inr 0 => 0
    | .inr 0, .inr 2 => 0
    | .inr 1, .inr 2 => 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm
declarations.doc: The mass term of the two Higgs doublet model potential.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def massTerm (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : ℝ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma massTerm_eq_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    massTerm P H = ∑ μ, P.ξ μ * H.gramVector μ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_massTerm
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_massTerm (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI) (P : PotentialParameters)
    (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    massTerm P (g • H) = massTerm P H

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_zero
declarations.statement: lemma massTerm_zero : massTerm 0 = 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_stabilityCounterExample
declarations.statement:
lemma massTerm_stabilityCounterExample (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    massTerm PotentialParameters.stabilityCounterExample H =
    2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).im

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm
declarations.doc: The quartic term of the two Higgs doublet model potential.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def quarticTerm (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : ℝ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_𝓵₄_expand
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTerm_𝓵₄_expand (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.quarticTerm P =
    1/2 * P.𝓵₁ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 + 1/2 * P.𝓵₂ * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2
    + P.𝓵₃ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2
    + P.𝓵₄ * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ).re
    + (1/2 * P.𝓵₅ * ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ ^ 2 + 1/2 * conj P.𝓵₅ * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ ^ 2).re
    + (P.𝓵₆ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ + conj P.𝓵₆ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ).re
    + (P.𝓵₇ * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ + conj P.𝓵₇ * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ).re

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTerm_eq_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    quarticTerm P H = ∑ a, ∑ b, H.gramVector a * H.gramVector b * P.η a b

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_quarticTerm
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_quarticTerm (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI) (P : PotentialParameters)
    (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    quarticTerm P (g • H) = quarticTerm P H

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_zero
declarations.statement: lemma quarticTerm_zero : quarticTerm 0 = 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    quarticTerm .stabilityCounterExample H =
    (‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 + ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).re) ^ 2

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample_eq_norm_pow_four
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample_eq_norm_pow_four (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    quarticTerm .stabilityCounterExample H = ‖H.Φ1 - H.Φ2‖ ^ 4

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample_nonneg
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample_nonneg (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    0 ≤ quarticTerm .stabilityCounterExample H

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_zero_of_quarticTerm_zero_stabilityCounterExample
declarations.statement:
lemma massTerm_zero_of_quarticTerm_zero_stabilityCounterExample (H : TwoHiggsDoublet)
    (h : quarticTerm .stabilityCounterExample H = 0) :
    massTerm .stabilityCounterExample H = 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potential
declarations.doc: The potential of the two Higgs doublet model.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def potential (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : ℝ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_potential
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_potential (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI)
    (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    potential P (g • H) = potential P H

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potential_zero
declarations.statement: lemma potential_zero : potential 0 = 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potential_stabilityCounterExample
declarations.statement:
lemma potential_stabilityCounterExample (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    potential .stabilityCounterExample H = 2 * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).im + ‖H.Φ1 - H.Φ2‖ ^ 4

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potential_eq_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma potential_eq_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    potential P H = ∑ μ, P.ξ μ * H.gramVector μ +
    ∑ a, ∑ b, H.gramVector a * H.gramVector b * P.η a b

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialIsStable
declarations.doc: The condition that the potential is stable.
declarations.statement: def PotentialIsStable (P : PotentialParameters) : Prop

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.stabilityCounterExample_not_potentialIsStable
declarations.doc: The potential `stabilityCounterExample` is not stable.
declarations.statement:
lemma stabilityCounterExample_not_potentialIsStable :
    ¬ PotentialIsStable .stabilityCounterExample

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced
declarations.doc:
A function related to the mass term of the potential, used in the stableness
condition and equivalent to the term `J2` in
https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].
declarations.statement: noncomputable def massTermReduced (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_lower_bound
declarations.statement:
lemma massTermReduced_lower_bound (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) : P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) - √(∑ a, |P.ξ (Sum.inr a)| ^ 2) ≤ massTermReduced P k

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_zero
declarations.statement: lemma massTermReduced_zero : massTermReduced 0 = 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample
declarations.statement:
lemma massTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    massTermReduced .stabilityCounterExample k = k 1

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced
declarations.doc:
A function related to the quartic term of the potential, used in the stableness
condition and equivalent to the term `J4` in
https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184 [ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184].
declarations.statement: noncomputable def quarticTermReduced (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced_zero
declarations.statement: lemma quarticTermReduced_zero : quarticTermReduced 0 = 0

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    quarticTermReduced .stabilityCounterExample k = (1 - k 0) ^ 2

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample_nonneg
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTermReduced_stabilityCounterExample_nonneg (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    0 ≤ quarticTermReduced .stabilityCounterExample k

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsStable_iff_forall_gramVector
declarations.statement:
lemma potentialIsStable_iff_forall_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsStable P ↔ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ K : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ K (Sum.inl 0) →
      ∑ μ : Fin 3, K (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2 ≤ K (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2 →
      c ≤ ∑ μ, P.ξ μ * K μ + ∑ a, ∑ b, K a * K b * P.η a b

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsStable_iff_forall_euclid
declarations.statement:
lemma potentialIsStable_iff_forall_euclid (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsStable P ↔ ∃ c, ∀ K0 : ℝ, ∀ K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 ≤ K0 →
      ‖K‖ ^ 2 ≤ K0 ^ 2 → c ≤ P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) * K0 + ∑ μ, P.ξ (Sum.inr μ) * K μ
      + K0 ^ 2 * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inl 0)
      + 2 * K0 * ∑ b, K b * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inr b) +
      ∑ a, ∑ b, K a * K b * P.η (Sum.inr a) (Sum.inr b)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsStable_iff_forall_euclid_lt
declarations.statement:
lemma potentialIsStable_iff_forall_euclid_lt (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsStable P ↔ ∃ c ≤ 0, ∀ K0 : ℝ, ∀ K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 < K0 →
      ‖K‖ ^ 2 ≤ K0 ^ 2 → c ≤ P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) * K0 + ∑ μ, P.ξ (Sum.inr μ) * K μ
      + K0 ^ 2 * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inl 0)
      + 2 * K0 * ∑ b, K b * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inr b) +
      ∑ a, ∑ b, K a * K b * P.η (Sum.inr a) (Sum.inr b)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsStable_iff_exists_forall_forall_reduced
declarations.statement:
lemma potentialIsStable_iff_exists_forall_forall_reduced (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsStable P ↔ ∃ c ≤ 0, ∀ K0 : ℝ, ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 < K0 →
      ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 → c ≤ K0 * massTermReduced P k + K0 ^ 2 * quarticTermReduced P k

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced_nonneg_of_potentialIsStable
declarations.statement:
lemma quarticTermReduced_nonneg_of_potentialIsStable (P : PotentialParameters)
    (hP : PotentialIsStable P) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ quarticTermReduced P k

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsStable_iff_massTermReduced_sq_le_quarticTermReduced
declarations.statement:
lemma potentialIsStable_iff_massTermReduced_sq_le_quarticTermReduced (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsStable P ↔ ∃ c, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ quarticTermReduced P k ∧
      (massTermReduced P k < 0 →
      massTermReduced P k ^ 2 ≤ 4 * quarticTermReduced P k * c)

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_pos_of_quarticTermReduced_zero_potentialIsStable
declarations.statement:
lemma massTermReduced_pos_of_quarticTermReduced_zero_potentialIsStable (P : PotentialParameters)
    (hP : PotentialIsStable P) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hq : quarticTermReduced P k = 0) : 0 ≤ massTermReduced P k

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsStable_of_strong
declarations.doc:
The potential is stable if it is strongly stable, i.e. its quartic term is always positive.
The proof of this result relies on the compactness of the closed unit ball in
`EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)`, and the `extreme value theorem`.
declarations.statement:
lemma potentialIsStable_of_strong (P : PotentialParameters)
    (h : ∀ k, ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 → 0 < quarticTermReduced P k) :
    PotentialIsStable P

declarations.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.forall_reduced_exists_not_potentialIsStable
declarations.doc:
A lemma invalidating the step in https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-ph/0605184
[ref: arxiv_hep_ph_0605184] leading to equation (4.4).
declarations.statement:
lemma forall_reduced_exists_not_potentialIsStable :
    ∃ P, ¬ PotentialIsStable P ∧ (∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
    0 ≤ quarticTermReduced P k ∧ (quarticTermReduced P k = 0 → 0 ≤ massTermReduced P k))

modules.title: The CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
The definition of the type of CKM matrices as unitary $3×3$-matrices.

An equivalence relation on CKM matrices is defined, where two matrices are equivalent if they are
related by phase shifts.

The notation `[V]ud` etc can be used for the elements of a CKM matrix, and
`[V]ud|us` etc for the ratios of elements.

declarations.name: phaseShiftMatrix
declarations.doc:
Given three real numbers `a b c` the complex matrix with `exp (I * a)` etc on the
leading diagonal.
declarations.statement: def phaseShiftMatrix (a b c : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ

declarations.name: phaseShiftMatrix_one
declarations.doc: The phase shift matrix for zero-phases is the identity.
declarations.statement: lemma phaseShiftMatrix_one : phaseShiftMatrix 0 0 0 = 1

declarations.name: phaseShiftMatrix_star
declarations.doc:
The conjugate transpose of the phase shift matrix is the phase-shift matrix
with negated phases.
declarations.statement:
lemma phaseShiftMatrix_star (a b c : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftMatrix a b c)ᴴ = phaseShiftMatrix (- a) (- b) (- c)

declarations.name: phaseShiftMatrix_mul
declarations.doc:
The multiple of two phase shift matrices is equal to the phase shift matrix with
added phases.
declarations.statement:
lemma phaseShiftMatrix_mul (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    phaseShiftMatrix a b c * phaseShiftMatrix d e f = phaseShiftMatrix (a + d) (b + e) (c + f)

declarations.name: phaseShift
declarations.doc:
Given three real numbers `a b c` the unitary matrix with `exp (I * a)` etc on the
leading diagonal.
declarations.statement: def phaseShift (a b c : ℝ) : unitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ

declarations.name: phaseShift_coe_matrix
declarations.doc:
The underlying matrix of the phase-shift element of the unitary group is the
phase-shift matrix.
declarations.statement: lemma phaseShift_coe_matrix (a b c : ℝ) : ↑(phaseShift a b c) = phaseShiftMatrix a b c

declarations.name: PhaseShiftRelation
declarations.doc:
The relation on unitary matrices (CKM matrices) satisfied if two unitary matrices
are related by phase shifts of quarks.
declarations.statement: def PhaseShiftRelation (U V : unitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) : Prop

declarations.name: phaseShiftRelation_refl
declarations.doc: The relation `PhaseShiftRelation` is reflective.
declarations.statement: lemma phaseShiftRelation_refl (U : unitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) : PhaseShiftRelation U U

declarations.name: phaseShiftRelation_symm
declarations.doc: The relation `PhaseShiftRelation` is symmetric.
declarations.statement:
lemma phaseShiftRelation_symm {U V : unitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ} :
    PhaseShiftRelation U V → PhaseShiftRelation V U

declarations.name: phaseShiftRelation_trans
declarations.doc: The relation `PhaseShiftRelation` is transitive.
declarations.statement:
lemma phaseShiftRelation_trans {U V W : unitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ} :
    PhaseShiftRelation U V → PhaseShiftRelation V W → PhaseShiftRelation U W

declarations.name: phaseShiftRelation_equiv
declarations.doc: The relation `PhaseShiftRelation` is an equivalence relation.
declarations.statement: lemma phaseShiftRelation_equiv : Equivalence PhaseShiftRelation

declarations.name: CKMMatrix
declarations.doc: The type of CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: def CKMMatrix : Type

declarations.name: CKMMatrix_ext
declarations.doc: Two CKM matrices are equal if their underlying unitary matrices are equal.
declarations.statement: lemma CKMMatrix_ext {U V : CKMMatrix} (h : U.val = V.val) : U = V

declarations.name: CKMMatrixSetoid
declarations.doc: The setoid of CKM matrices defined by phase shifts of fermions.
declarations.statement: instance CKMMatrixSetoid : Setoid CKMMatrix

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply
declarations.doc: The matrix obtained from `V` by shifting the phases of the fermions.
declarations.statement: def phaseShiftApply (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) : CKMMatrix

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.equiv
declarations.doc: A CKM matrix is equivalent to a phase-shift of itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma equiv (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    V ≈ phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ud
declarations.doc: The `ud` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma ud (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 0 0 = cexp (a * I + d * I) * V.1 0 0

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.us
declarations.doc: The `us` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma us (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 0 1 = cexp (a * I + e * I) * V.1 0 1

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ub
declarations.doc: The `ub` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma ub (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 0 2 = cexp (a * I + f * I) * V.1 0 2

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.cd
declarations.doc: The `cd` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma cd (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 1 0= cexp (b * I + d * I) * V.1 1 0

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.cs
declarations.doc: The `cs` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma cs (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 1 1 = cexp (b * I + e * I) * V.1 1 1

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.cb
declarations.doc: The `cb` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma cb (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 1 2 = cexp (b * I + f * I) * V.1 1 2

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.td
declarations.doc: The `td` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma td (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 2 0= cexp (c * I + d * I) * V.1 2 0

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ts
declarations.doc: The `ts` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma ts (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 2 1 = cexp (c * I + e * I) * V.1 2 1

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.tb
declarations.doc: The `tb` component of the CKM matrix obtained after applying a phase shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma tb (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (phaseShiftApply V a b c d e f).1 2 2 = cexp (c * I + f * I) * V.1 2 2

declarations.name: VAbs'
declarations.doc: The absolute value of the `(i,j)`th element of `V`.
declarations.statement: def VAbs' (V : unitaryGroup (Fin 3) ℂ) (i j : Fin 3) : ℝ

declarations.name: VAbs'_equiv
declarations.doc:
If two CKM matrices are equivalent (under phase shifts), then their absolute values
are the same.
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs'_equiv (i j : Fin 3) (V U : CKMMatrix) (h : V ≈ U) :
    VAbs' V i j = VAbs' U i j

declarations.name: VAbs
declarations.doc: The absolute value of the `(i,j)`th any representative of `⟦V⟧`.
declarations.statement: def VAbs (i j : Fin 3) : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid → ℝ

declarations.name: VudAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `ud`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VudAbs

declarations.name: VusAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `us`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VusAbs

declarations.name: VubAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `ub`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VubAbs

declarations.name: VcdAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `cd`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VcdAbs

declarations.name: VcsAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `cs`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VcsAbs

declarations.name: VcbAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `cb`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VcbAbs

declarations.name: VtdAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `td`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VtdAbs

declarations.name: VtsAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `ts`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VtsAbs

declarations.name: VtbAbs
declarations.doc:
The absolute value of the `tb`th element of a representative of an equivalence class of
CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: abbrev VtbAbs

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rubud
declarations.doc: The ratio of the `ub` and `ud` elements of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def Rubud (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rusud
declarations.doc: The ratio of the `us` and `ud` elements of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def Rusud (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rudus
declarations.doc: The ratio of the `ud` and `us` elements of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def Rudus (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rubus
declarations.doc: The ratio of the `ub` and `us` elements of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def Rubus (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rcdcb
declarations.doc: The ratio of the `cd` and `cb` elements of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def Rcdcb (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rcdcb_mul_cb
declarations.statement: lemma Rcdcb_mul_cb {V : CKMMatrix} (h : [V]cb ≠ 0) : [V]cd = Rcdcb V * [V]cb

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rcscb
declarations.doc: The ratio of the `cs` and `cb` elements of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def Rcscb (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Rcscb_mul_cb
declarations.doc:
Multiplying the ratio of the `cs` by `cb` element of a CKM matrix by the `cb` element
returns the `cs` element, as long as the `cb` element is non-zero.
declarations.statement: lemma Rcscb_mul_cb {V : CKMMatrix} (h : [V]cb ≠ 0) : [V]cs = Rcscb V * [V]cb

modules.title: Invariants of the CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
The CKM matrix is only defined up to an equivalence.

This file defines some invariants of the CKM matrix, which are well-defined with respect to
this equivalence.

Of note, this file defines the complex jarlskog invariant.

declarations.name: Invariant.jarlskogℂCKM
declarations.doc: The complex jarlskog invariant for a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def jarlskogℂCKM (V : CKMMatrix) : ℂ

declarations.name: Invariant.jarlskogℂCKM_equiv
declarations.doc: The complex jarlskog invariant is equal for equivalent CKM matrices.
declarations.statement:
lemma jarlskogℂCKM_equiv (V U : CKMMatrix) (h : V ≈ U) :
    jarlskogℂCKM V = jarlskogℂCKM U

declarations.name: Invariant.jarlskogℂ
declarations.doc: The complex jarlskog invariant for an equivalence class of CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: def jarlskogℂ : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid → ℂ

declarations.name: Invariant.VusVubVcdSq
declarations.doc:
An invariant for CKM matrices corresponding to the square of the absolute values
of the `us`, `ub` and `cb` elements multiplied together divided by `(VudAbs V ^ 2 + VusAbs V ^2)`.
declarations.statement: def VusVubVcdSq (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) : ℝ

declarations.name: Invariant.mulExpδ₁₃
declarations.doc:
An invariant for CKM matrices. The argument of this invariant is `δ₁₃` in the
standard parameterization.
declarations.statement: def mulExpδ₁₃ (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) : ℂ

modules.title: Phase freedom of the CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
The CKM matrix is only defined up to an equivalence. This leads to a freedom
to shift the phases of the matrices elements of the CKM matrix.

In this file we define two sets of conditions on the CKM matrices
`fstRowThdColRealCond` which we show can be satisfied by any CKM matrix up to equivalence
and `ubOnePhaseCond` which we show can be satisfied by any CKM matrix up to equivalence as long as
the ub element as absolute value 1.

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_ud_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_ud_phase_zero (V : CKMMatrix) (h1 : u + d = - arg [V]ud) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]ud = VudAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_us_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_us_phase_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : u + s = - arg [V]us) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]us = VusAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_ub_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_ub_phase_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : u + b = - arg [V]ub) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]ub = VubAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_cs_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_cs_phase_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : c + s = - arg [V]cs) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]cs = VcsAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_cb_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_cb_phase_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : c + b = - arg [V]cb) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]cb = VcbAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_tb_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_tb_phase_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : t + b = - arg [V]tb) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]tb = VtbAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_cd_phase_pi
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_cd_phase_pi {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : c + d = Real.pi - arg [V]cd) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]cd = - VcdAbs ⟦V⟧

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.shift_cross_product_phase_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma shift_cross_product_phase_zero {V : CKMMatrix} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : cexp (τ * I) • (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) = [V]t) (h1 : τ = - u - c - t - d - s - b) :
    [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]t =
    conj [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]u ⨯₃ conj [phaseShiftApply V u c t d s b]c

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.FstRowThdColRealCond
declarations.doc:
A proposition which is satisfied by a CKM matrix if its `ud`, `us`, `cb` and `tb` elements
are positive and real, and there is no phase difference between the `t`th-row and
the cross product of the conjugates of the `u`th and `c`th rows.
declarations.statement: def FstRowThdColRealCond (U : CKMMatrix) : Prop

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.ubOnePhaseCond
declarations.doc:
A proposition which is satisfied by a CKM matrix `ub` is one, `ud`, `us` and `cb` are zero,
  there is no phase difference between the `t`th-row and
the cross product of the conjugates of the `u`th and `c`th rows, and the `cd`th and `cs`th
elements are real and related in a set way.
declarations.statement: def ubOnePhaseCond (U : CKMMatrix) : Prop

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.fstRowThdColRealCond_shift_solution
declarations.statement:
lemma fstRowThdColRealCond_shift_solution {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : a + d = - arg [V]ud)
    (h2 : a + e = - arg [V]us) (h3 : b + f = - arg [V]cb)
    (h4 : c + f = - arg [V]tb) (h5 : τ = - a - b - c - d - e - f) :
    b = - τ + arg [V]ud + arg [V]us + arg [V]tb + a ∧
    c = - τ + arg [V]cb + arg [V]ud + arg [V]us + a ∧
    d = - arg [V]ud - a ∧
    e = - arg [V]us - a ∧
    f = τ - arg [V]ud - arg [V]us - arg [V]cb - arg [V]tb - a

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.ubOnePhaseCond_shift_solution
declarations.statement:
lemma ubOnePhaseCond_shift_solution {V : CKMMatrix} (h1 : a + f = - arg [V]ub)
    (h2 : 0 = - a - b - c - d - e - f)
    (h3 : b + d = Real.pi - arg [V]cd) (h5 : b + e = - arg [V]cs) :
    c = - Real.pi + arg [V]cd + arg [V]cs + arg [V]ub + b ∧
    d = Real.pi - arg [V]cd - b ∧
    e = - arg [V]cs - b ∧
    f = - arg [V]ub - a

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.fstRowThdColRealCond_holds_up_to_equiv
declarations.statement:
lemma fstRowThdColRealCond_holds_up_to_equiv (V : CKMMatrix) :
    ∃ (U : CKMMatrix), V ≈ U ∧ FstRowThdColRealCond U

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.ubOnePhaseCond_hold_up_to_equiv_of_ub_one
declarations.statement:
lemma ubOnePhaseCond_hold_up_to_equiv_of_ub_one {V : CKMMatrix} (hb : ¬ ([V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0))
    (hV : FstRowThdColRealCond V) :
    ∃ (U : CKMMatrix), V ≈ U ∧ ubOnePhaseCond U

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cd_of_fstRowThdColRealCond
declarations.statement:
lemma cd_of_fstRowThdColRealCond {V : CKMMatrix} (hb : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0)
    (hV : FstRowThdColRealCond V) :
    [V]cd = (- VtbAbs ⟦V⟧ * VusAbs ⟦V⟧ / (VudAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2 + VusAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2)) +
    (- VubAbs ⟦V⟧ * VudAbs ⟦V⟧ * VcbAbs ⟦V⟧ / (VudAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2 + VusAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2))
    * cexp (- arg [V]ub * I)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cs_of_fstRowThdColRealCond
declarations.statement:
lemma cs_of_fstRowThdColRealCond {V : CKMMatrix} (hb : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0)
    (hV : FstRowThdColRealCond V) :
    [V]cs = (VtbAbs ⟦V⟧ * VudAbs ⟦V⟧ / (VudAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2 + VusAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2))
    + (- VubAbs ⟦V⟧ * VusAbs ⟦V⟧ * VcbAbs ⟦V⟧/ (VudAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2 + VusAbs ⟦V⟧ ^2))
    * cexp (- arg [V]ub * I)

modules.title: Relations for the CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
This file contains a collection of relations and properties between the elements of the CKM
matrix.

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_sum_sq_row_eq_one
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of any row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `Vabs`.
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs_sum_sq_row_eq_one (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) (i : Fin 3) :
    (VAbs i 0 V) ^ 2 + (VAbs i 1 V) ^ 2 + (VAbs i 2 V) ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.fst_row_normalized_abs
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of the first row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `norm`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fst_row_normalized_abs (V : CKMMatrix) :
    norm [V]ud ^ 2 + norm [V]us ^ 2 + norm [V]ub ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.snd_row_normalized_abs
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of the second row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `norm`.
declarations.statement:
lemma snd_row_normalized_abs (V : CKMMatrix) :
    norm [V]cd ^ 2 + norm [V]cs ^ 2 + norm [V]cb ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.thd_row_normalized_abs
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of the third row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `norm`.
declarations.statement:
lemma thd_row_normalized_abs (V : CKMMatrix) :
    norm [V]td ^ 2 + norm [V]ts ^ 2 + norm [V]tb ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.fst_row_normalized_normSq
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of the first row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `nomSq`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fst_row_normalized_normSq (V : CKMMatrix) :
    normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us + normSq [V]ub = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.snd_row_normalized_normSq
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of the second row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `nomSq`.
declarations.statement:
lemma snd_row_normalized_normSq (V : CKMMatrix) :
    normSq [V]cd + normSq [V]cs + normSq [V]cb = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.thd_row_normalized_normSq
declarations.doc: The absolute value squared of the third row of a CKM matrix is `1`, in terms of `nomSq`.
declarations.statement:
lemma thd_row_normalized_normSq (V : CKMMatrix) :
    normSq [V]td + normSq [V]ts + normSq [V]tb = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.normSq_Vud_plus_normSq_Vus
declarations.statement:
lemma normSq_Vud_plus_normSq_Vus (V : CKMMatrix) :
    normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us = 1 - normSq [V]ub

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VudAbs_sq_add_VusAbs_sq
declarations.statement: lemma VudAbs_sq_add_VusAbs_sq : VudAbs V ^ 2 + VusAbs V ^2 = 1 - VubAbs V ^2

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.ud_us_ne_zero_iff_ub_ne_one
declarations.statement:
lemma ud_us_ne_zero_iff_ub_ne_one (V : CKMMatrix) :
    [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0 ↔ norm [V]ub ≠ 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.normSq_Vud_plus_normSq_Vus_ne_zero_ℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma normSq_Vud_plus_normSq_Vus_ne_zero_ℝ {V : CKMMatrix} (hb : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0) :
    normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us ≠ 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbsub_ne_zero_Vud_Vus_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbsub_ne_zero_Vud_Vus_ne_zero {V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid}
    (hV : VAbs 0 2 V ≠ 1) :(VudAbs V ^ 2 + VusAbs V ^ 2) ≠ 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbsub_ne_zero_sqrt_Vud_Vus_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbsub_ne_zero_sqrt_Vud_Vus_ne_zero {V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid}
    (hV : VAbs 0 2 V ≠ 1) : √(VudAbs V ^ 2 + VusAbs V ^ 2) ≠ 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.normSq_Vud_plus_normSq_Vus_ne_zero_ℂ
declarations.statement:
lemma normSq_Vud_plus_normSq_Vus_ne_zero_ℂ {V : CKMMatrix} (hb : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0) :
    (normSq [V]ud : ℂ) + normSq [V]us ≠ 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Vabs_sq_add_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma Vabs_sq_add_ne_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (hb : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0) :
    ((VudAbs ⟦V⟧ : ℂ) * ↑(VudAbs ⟦V⟧) + ↑(VusAbs ⟦V⟧) * ↑(VusAbs ⟦V⟧)) ≠ 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.fst_row_orthog_snd_row
declarations.statement:
lemma fst_row_orthog_snd_row (V : CKMMatrix) :
    [V]cd * conj [V]ud + [V]cs * conj [V]us + [V]cb * conj [V]ub = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.fst_row_orthog_thd_row
declarations.statement:
lemma fst_row_orthog_thd_row (V : CKMMatrix) :
    [V]td * conj [V]ud + [V]ts * conj [V]us + [V]tb * conj [V]ub = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Vcd_mul_conj_Vud
declarations.statement:
lemma Vcd_mul_conj_Vud (V : CKMMatrix) :
    [V]cd * conj [V]ud = -[V]cs * conj [V]us - [V]cb * conj [V]ub

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.Vcs_mul_conj_Vus
declarations.statement:
lemma Vcs_mul_conj_Vus (V : CKMMatrix) :
    [V]cs * conj [V]us = - [V]cd * conj [V]ud - [V]cb * conj [V]ub

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_thd_eq_one_fst_eq_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs_thd_eq_one_fst_eq_zero {V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid} {i : Fin 3} (hV : VAbs i 2 V = 1) :
    VAbs i 0 V = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_thd_eq_one_snd_eq_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs_thd_eq_one_snd_eq_zero {V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid} {i : Fin 3} (hV : VAbs i 2 V = 1) :
    VAbs i 1 V = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.conj_Vtb_cross_product
CKMMatrix.conj_Vtb_mul_Vud
declarations.statement:
lemma conj_Vtb_mul_Vud {V : CKMMatrix} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : [V]t = cexp (τ * I) • (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c)) :
    cexp (τ * I) * conj [V]tb * conj [V]ud =
    [V]cs * (normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us) + [V]cb * conj [V]ub * [V]us

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.conj_Vtb_mul_Vus
declarations.statement:
lemma conj_Vtb_mul_Vus {V : CKMMatrix} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : [V]t = cexp (τ * I) • (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c)) :
    cexp (τ * I) * conj [V]tb * conj [V]us =
    - ([V]cd * (normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us) + [V]cb * conj ([V]ub) * [V]ud)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cs_of_ud_us_ub_cb_tb
declarations.statement:
lemma cs_of_ud_us_ub_cb_tb {V : CKMMatrix} (h : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : [V]t = cexp (τ * I) • (conj ([V]u) ⨯₃ conj ([V]c))) :
    [V]cs = (- conj [V]ub * [V]us * [V]cb +
      cexp (τ * I) * conj [V]tb * conj [V]ud) / (normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cd_of_ud_us_ub_cb_tb
declarations.statement:
lemma cd_of_ud_us_ub_cb_tb {V : CKMMatrix} (h : [V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : [V]t = cexp (τ * I) • (conj ([V]u) ⨯₃ conj ([V]c))) :
    [V]cd = - (conj [V]ub * [V]ud * [V]cb + cexp (τ * I) * conj [V]tb * conj [V]us) /
      (normSq [V]ud + normSq [V]us)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_ge_zero
declarations.statement: lemma VAbs_ge_zero (i j : Fin 3) (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) : 0 ≤ VAbs i j V

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_leq_one
declarations.statement: lemma VAbs_leq_one (i j : Fin 3) (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) : VAbs i j V ≤ 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_sum_sq_col_eq_one
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs_sum_sq_col_eq_one (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) (i : Fin 3) :
    (VAbs 0 i V) ^ 2 + (VAbs 1 i V) ^ 2 + (VAbs 2 i V) ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.thd_col_normalized_abs
declarations.statement:
lemma thd_col_normalized_abs (V : CKMMatrix) :
    norm [V]ub ^ 2 + norm [V]cb ^ 2 + norm [V]tb ^ 2 = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.thd_col_normalized_normSq
declarations.statement:
lemma thd_col_normalized_normSq (V : CKMMatrix) :
    normSq [V]ub + normSq [V]cb + normSq [V]tb = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cb_eq_zero_of_ud_us_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma cb_eq_zero_of_ud_us_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (h : [V]ud = 0 ∧ [V]us = 0) :
    [V]cb = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cs_of_ud_us_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma cs_of_ud_us_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (ha : ¬ ([V]ud ≠ 0 ∨ [V]us ≠ 0)) :
    VcsAbs ⟦V⟧ = √(1 - VcdAbs ⟦V⟧ ^ 2)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VcbAbs_sq_add_VtbAbs_sq
declarations.statement:
lemma VcbAbs_sq_add_VtbAbs_sq (V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid) :
    VcbAbs V ^ 2 + VtbAbs V ^ 2 = 1 - VubAbs V ^2

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cb_tb_ne_zero_iff_ub_ne_one
declarations.statement:
lemma cb_tb_ne_zero_iff_ub_ne_one (V : CKMMatrix) :
    [V]cb ≠ 0 ∨ [V]tb ≠ 0 ↔ norm [V]ub ≠ 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_fst_col_eq_one_snd_eq_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs_fst_col_eq_one_snd_eq_zero {V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid} {i : Fin 3}
    (hV : VAbs 0 i V = 1) : VAbs 1 i V = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.VAbs_fst_col_eq_one_thd_eq_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma VAbs_fst_col_eq_one_thd_eq_zero {V : Quotient CKMMatrixSetoid} {i : Fin 3}
    (hV : VAbs 0 i V = 1) : VAbs 2 i V = 0

modules.title: Rows for the CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
This file contains the definition extracting the rows of the CKM matrix and
proves some properties between them.

The first row can be extracted as `[V]u` for a CKM matrix `V`.

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow
declarations.doc: The `u`th row of the CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def uRow (V : CKMMatrix) : Fin 3 → ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow
declarations.doc: The `c`th row of the CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def cRow (V : CKMMatrix) : Fin 3 → ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.tRow
declarations.doc: The `t`th row of the CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def tRow (V : CKMMatrix) : Fin 3 → ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_normalized
declarations.doc: The up-quark row of the CKM matrix is normalized to `1`.
declarations.statement: lemma uRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]u ⬝ᵥ [V]u = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow_normalized
declarations.doc: The charm-quark row of the CKM matrix is normalized to `1`.
declarations.statement: lemma cRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]c ⬝ᵥ [V]c = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.tRow_normalized
declarations.doc: The top-quark row of the CKM matrix is normalized to `1`.
declarations.statement: lemma tRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]t ⬝ᵥ [V]t = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_cRow_orthog
declarations.doc: The up-quark row of the CKM matrix is orthogonal to the charm-quark row.
declarations.statement: lemma uRow_cRow_orthog (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]u ⬝ᵥ [V]c = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_tRow_orthog
declarations.doc: The up-quark row of the CKM matrix is orthogonal to the top-quark row.
declarations.statement: lemma uRow_tRow_orthog (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]u ⬝ᵥ [V]t = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow_uRow_orthog
declarations.doc: The charm-quark row of the CKM matrix is orthogonal to the up-quark row.
declarations.statement: lemma cRow_uRow_orthog (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]c ⬝ᵥ [V]u = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow_tRow_orthog
declarations.doc: The charm-quark row of the CKM matrix is orthogonal to the top-quark row.
declarations.statement: lemma cRow_tRow_orthog (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]c ⬝ᵥ [V]t = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.tRow_uRow_orthog
declarations.doc: The top-quark row of the CKM matrix is orthogonal to the up-quark row.
declarations.statement: lemma tRow_uRow_orthog (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]t ⬝ᵥ [V]u = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.tRow_cRow_orthog
declarations.doc: The top-quark row of the CKM matrix is orthogonal to the charm-quark row.
declarations.statement: lemma tRow_cRow_orthog (V : CKMMatrix) : conj [V]t ⬝ᵥ [V]c = 0

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_cross_cRow_conj
declarations.statement: lemma uRow_cross_cRow_conj (V : CKMMatrix) : conj (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) = [V]u ⨯₃ [V]c

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow_cross_tRow_conj
declarations.statement: lemma cRow_cross_tRow_conj (V : CKMMatrix) : conj (conj [V]c ⨯₃ conj [V]t) = [V]c ⨯₃ [V]t

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_cross_cRow_normalized
declarations.statement:
lemma uRow_cross_cRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) :
    conj (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) ⬝ᵥ (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow_cross_tRow_normalized
declarations.statement:
lemma cRow_cross_tRow_normalized (V : CKMMatrix) :
    conj (conj [V]c ⨯₃ conj [V]t) ⬝ᵥ (conj [V]c ⨯₃ conj [V]t) = 1

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.rows
declarations.doc: A map from `Fin 3` to each row of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def rows (V : CKMMatrix) : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.rows_linearly_independent
declarations.doc: The rows of a CKM matrix are linearly independent.
declarations.statement: lemma rows_linearly_independent (V : CKMMatrix) : LinearIndependent ℂ (rows V)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.rowBasis
declarations.doc: The rows of a CKM matrix as a basis of `ℂ³`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def rowBasis (V : CKMMatrix) : Basis (Fin 3) ℂ (Fin 3 → ℂ)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.cRow_cross_tRow_eq_uRow
declarations.statement:
lemma cRow_cross_tRow_eq_uRow (V : CKMMatrix) :
    ∃ (κ : ℝ), [V]u = cexp (κ * I) • (conj [V]c ⨯₃ conj [V]t)

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.uRow_cross_cRow_eq_tRow
declarations.statement:
lemma uRow_cross_cRow_eq_tRow (V : CKMMatrix) :
    ∃ (τ : ℝ), [V]t = cexp (τ * I) • (conj ([V]u) ⨯₃ conj ([V]c))

declarations.name: CKMMatrix.ext_Rows
declarations.statement:
lemma ext_Rows {U V : CKMMatrix} (hu : [U]u = [V]u) (hc : [U]c = [V]c) (ht : [U]t = [V]t) :
    U = V

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ucCross
declarations.doc: The cross product of the conjugate of the `u` and `c` rows of a CKM matrix.
declarations.statement: def ucCross : Fin 3 → ℂ

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ucCross_fst
declarations.statement:
lemma ucCross_fst (V : CKMMatrix) : (ucCross V a b c d e f) 0 =
    cexp ((- a * I) + (- b * I) + (- e * I) + (- f * I)) * (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) 0

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ucCross_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma ucCross_snd (V : CKMMatrix) : (ucCross V a b c d e f) 1 =
    cexp ((- a * I) + (- b * I) + (- d * I) + (- f * I)) * (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) 1

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.ucCross_thd
declarations.statement:
lemma ucCross_thd (V : CKMMatrix) : (ucCross V a b c d e f) 2 =
    cexp ((- a * I) + (- b * I) + (- d * I) + (- e * I)) * (conj [V]u ⨯₃ conj [V]c) 2

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.uRow_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma uRow_mul (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c : ℝ) :
    [phaseShiftApply V a b c 0 0 0]u = cexp (a * I) • [V]u

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.cRow_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma cRow_mul (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c : ℝ) :
    [phaseShiftApply V a b c 0 0 0]c = cexp (b * I) • [V]c

declarations.name: phaseShiftApply.tRow_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma tRow_mul (V : CKMMatrix) (a b c : ℝ) :
    [phaseShiftApply V a b c 0 0 0]t = cexp (c * I) • [V]t

modules.title: Standard parameterization for the CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
This file defines the standard parameterization of CKM matrices in terms of
four real numbers `θ₁₂`, `θ₁₃`, `θ₂₃` and `δ₁₃`.

We will show that every CKM matrix can be written within this standard parameterization
in the file `FlavorPhysics.CKMMatrix.StandardParameters`.

declarations.name: standParamAsMatrix
declarations.doc:
Given four reals `θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃` the standard parameterization of the CKM matrix
as a `3×3` complex matrix.
declarations.statement: def standParamAsMatrix (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ

declarations.name: standParamAsMatrix_unitary
declarations.doc: The standard parameterization forms a unitary matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma standParamAsMatrix_unitary (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ) :
    ((standParamAsMatrix θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃)ᴴ * standParamAsMatrix θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃) = 1

declarations.name: standParam
declarations.doc:
A CKM Matrix from four reals `θ₁₂`, `θ₁₃`, `θ₂₃`, and `δ₁₃`. This is the standard
parameterization of CKM matrices.
declarations.statement: def standParam (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ) : CKMMatrix

declarations.name: standParam.cross_product_t
declarations.doc:
The top-row of the standard parameterization is the cross product of the conjugate of the
up and charm rows.
declarations.statement:
lemma cross_product_t (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ) :
    [standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃]t =
    (conj [standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃]u ⨯₃ conj [standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃]c)

declarations.name: standParam.eq_rows
declarations.doc:
A CKM matrix which has rows equal to that of a standard parameterisation is equal
to that standard parameterisation.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_rows (U : CKMMatrix) {θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ} (hu : [U]u = [standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃]u)
    (hc : [U]c = [standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃]c) (hU : [U]t = conj [U]u ⨯₃ conj [U]c) :
    U = standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃

declarations.name: standParam.eq_exp_of_phases
declarations.doc:
Two standard parameterisations of CKM matrices are the same matrix if they have
the same angles and the exponential of their faces is equal.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_exp_of_phases (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ δ₁₃' : ℝ) (h : cexp (δ₁₃ * I) = cexp (δ₁₃' * I)) :
    standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ = standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃'

declarations.name: standParam.VusVubVcdSq_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma VusVubVcdSq_eq (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ) (h1 : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ₁₂)
    (h2 : 0 ≤ Real.cos θ₁₃) (h3 : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ₂₃) (h4 : 0 ≤ Real.cos θ₁₂) :
    VusVubVcdSq ⟦standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃⟧ =
    Real.sin θ₁₂ ^ 2 * Real.cos θ₁₃ ^ 2 * Real.sin θ₁₃ ^ 2 * Real.sin θ₂₃ ^ 2

declarations.name: standParam.mulExpδ₁₃_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma mulExpδ₁₃_eq (θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃ : ℝ) (h1 : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ₁₂)
    (h2 : 0 ≤ Real.cos θ₁₃) (h3 : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ₂₃) (h4 : 0 ≤ Real.cos θ₁₂) :
    mulExpδ₁₃ ⟦standParam θ₁₂ θ₁₃ θ₂₃ δ₁₃⟧ =
    sin θ₁₂ * cos θ₁₃ ^ 2 * sin θ₂₃ * sin θ₁₃ * cos θ₁₂ * cos θ₂₃ * cexp (I * δ₁₃)

modules.title: Standard parameters for the CKM Matrix
modules.doc:
Given a CKM matrix `V` we can extract four real numbers `θ₁₂`, `θ₁₃`, `θ₂₃` and `δ₁₃`.
These, when used in the standard parameterization return `V` up to equivalence.

This leads to the theorem `standParam.exists_for_CKMatrix` which says that up to equivalence every
CKM matrix can be written using the standard parameterization.

declarations.statement:

    VubAbs V = 1

declarations.name: Vs_zero_iff_cos_sin_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma Vs_zero_iff_cos_sin_zero (V : CKMMatrix) :
    VudAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VubAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VusAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VcbAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VtbAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0
    ↔ Real.cos (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) = 0 ∨ Real.cos (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) = 0 ∨ Real.cos (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) = 0 ∨
      Real.sin (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) = 0 ∨ Real.sin (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) = 0 ∨ Real.sin (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) = 0

declarations.name: standParam.mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_δ₁₃
declarations.statement:
lemma mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_δ₁₃ (V : CKMMatrix) (δ₁₃ : ℝ) :
    mulExpδ₁₃ ⟦standParam (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) δ₁₃⟧ =
    sin (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) * cos (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) ^ 2 * sin (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) * sin (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧)
    * cos (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) * cos (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) * cexp (I * δ₁₃)

declarations.name: standParam.mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_eq_zero_iff (V : CKMMatrix) (δ₁₃ : ℝ) :
    mulExpδ₁₃ ⟦standParam (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) δ₁₃⟧ = 0 ↔
      VudAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VubAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VusAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VcbAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0 ∨ VtbAbs ⟦V⟧ = 0

declarations.name: standParam.mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_abs
declarations.statement:
lemma mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_abs (V : CKMMatrix) (δ₁₃ : ℝ) :
    norm (mulExpδ₁₃ ⟦standParam (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) δ₁₃⟧) =
    sin (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) * cos (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) ^ 2 * sin (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) * sin (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧)
    * cos (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) * cos (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧)

declarations.name: standParam.mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_ne_zero_arg
declarations.statement:
lemma mulExpδ₁₃_on_param_ne_zero_arg (V : CKMMatrix) (δ₁₃ : ℝ)
    (h1 : mulExpδ₁₃ ⟦standParam (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) δ₁₃⟧ ≠ 0) :
    cexp (arg (mulExpδ₁₃ ⟦standParam (θ₁₂ ⟦V⟧) (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) (θ₂₃ ⟦V⟧) δ₁₃⟧) * I) =
    cexp (δ₁₃ * I)

declarations.name: standParam.on_param_cos_θ₁₃_eq_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma on_param_cos_θ₁₃_eq_zero {V : CKMMatrix} (δ₁₃ : ℝ) (h : Real.cos (θ₁₃ ⟦V⟧) = 0) :
